**Risk flags:**  
- Defendant in 6 case(s), total claims RM 892,500  
- Single shareholder holds 98.86%  
- Only 2 year(s) of financials available  

**Overview:**  
Cahaya Seri Catering Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated on 2017‑11‑20, operating in Sabah’s food & beverage sector. It wholesales frozen food to restaurants. The firm has three directors, with a single shareholder controlling 98.86% of the equity. Financial disclosures cover two years, showing revenues of RM 4,205,420 and RM 4,419,464 and equity of RM 1,690,966 and RM 1,945,146 respectively; net profit, audit opinion and current ratio are not provided.
